sql: SELECT 'col' AS k, table_name || '.' || column_name || ' ' || data_type || ' null=' || is_nullable AS txt FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND ((table_name = 'company_events' AND column_name IN ('data_fechamento_venda','company_id')) OR (table_name = 'wapi_instances' AND column_name IN ('status','phone_number','company_id','connected_at')) OR (table_name = 'lead_history' AND column_name IN ('action','company_id','created_at')) OR (table_name = 'wapi_messages' AND column_name IN ('timestamp','created_at','from_me','company_id')) OR (table_name = 'wapi_conversations' AND column_name IN ('created_at','is_closed','lead_id')) OR (table_name = 'campaign_leads' AND column_name IN ('status','created_at')) OR (table_name = 'companies' AND column_name IN ('parent_id','logo_url','is_active'))) UNION ALL SELECT 'sent90', count(*) FILTER (WHERE from_me)::text || ' / ' || count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT from_me)::text FROM wapi_messages WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '90 days' UNION ALL SELECT 'nullts', count(*)::text FROM wapi_messages WHERE timestamp IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'companies', count(*) FILTER (WHERE parent_id IS NULL)::text || ' pais / ' || count(*) FILTER (WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL)::text || ' filhas' FROM companies UNION ALL SELECT 'convnolead', count(*) FILTER (WHERE lead_id IS NULL)::text || ' / ' || count(*)::text FROM wapi_conversations
